description: Create order model, order service, checkout component, and update cart page with Proceed to Checkout button. Also update routes.
steps: Create order model at src/app/models/order.model.ts with Order interface (id: string, items: CartItem[], total: number, cardholderName: string, cardLastFour: string, orderDate: Date)
Create OrderService at src/app/services/order.service.ts with BehaviorSubject<Order|null>, placeOrder(), getLastOrder(), clearOrder() methods following CartService pattern

Create checkout component at src/app/components/checkout/checkout.component.ts - standalone, inline template/styles, reactive form with cardholderName, cardNumber (16 digits), expiryDate (MM/YY), cvv (3-4 digits), shows cart summary, submit clears cart and navigates to /order-confirmation

Create order confirmation component at src/app/components/order-confirmation/order-confirmation.component.ts - standalone, inline template/styles, reads last order from OrderService, displays order details
Update src/app/app.routes.ts to add checkout and order-confirmation routes before the ** wildcard
Update src/app/components/cart/cart.component.ts to add 'Proceed to Checkout' button (routerLink to /checkout) in cart-actions div
acceptance_criteria: npx ng build completes without errors
Checkout component has reactive form with proper validation
Order confirmation component displays order details
Cart page has Proceed to Checkout button
